# Active goal: codebase cleanup and AST tool validation

Owner explicitly requested a goal on 2026-09-20, then clarified this is both codebase cleanup and tool use/testing/validation.

Worktree: /home/inktomi/.codex/worktrees/world-aware-tools/orbweaver
Branch: codex/world-aware-tools. Main is Claude-owned; no merge/push authorized.

For every registered AST verb, record implementation, corpus, native-world assumptions, controls, actual-use receipt, findings and disposition. Query helpers need representative use; audit lenses need the complete relevant scope with uncapped JSON and denominator. Do not infer global absence from a partial result. Candidate findings require structural and corroborating searches, live production paths and intent review before cleanup. Fix confirmed tool errors with in-memory controls. Keep deliberate tuple/type/schema twins, API surfaces and test seams. Prelaunch: old development data is not itself a compatibility veto, but legitimate null/optional semantics and evolving persisted shapes remain relevant.

Current commits: f6164abe4 native tooling worlds; 6f584a8f0 AST repo test optimization; 527cdd0bc shorthand liveness fix. All unmerged.
Current tracked implementation: #2512 canonical schema reuse/connection boundary validation, with caption metadata write-boundary followup.
Completed audit receipts: /tmp/world-tools-testonly-after.json (147 all-package candidates); /tmp/world-tools-contracts-rot.log (complete 29 orphans,39 testonly,0chains,2typeonly,0swallowed); /tmp/world-tools-contracts-audit.md contains adjudication.
Pending closed verb inventory: /tmp/world-tools-lens-manifest.json from ast_worlds.

Owner added explicit deletion requirement: before deleting based on non-presence, root and every lane MUST corroborate with actual ast-grep over both TS and TSX, record scanned scope/file counts and classify remaining hits; AST lens plus caller/intent review still apply. An 'ast-grep-style' description or rg alone is insufficient. No in-repo plants. Implementation lanes were notified before current cleanup deletions; reviewers must enforce receipts.

Current completed application batch:3512e3036 (#2512) committed on owned branch, Review;317focused tests,9native programs + final root rerun,independent review. Static integration barrier pending. Current tooling batch#2513/#2514/#2515 frozen/review:99tests,root/toolingnative,lint; corrected full fieldscan48findings; old49raw candidates became48after removing compound-write falsepositive, old45emitted had lostsame-line records. Corrected parsed JSON /tmp/world-tools-contract-field-liveness-after.parsed.json.

Active cleanup lanes:security contracts_boundary_review #2516 retired endpointprobe +unusedregexsingletonaliases; executor codemod_worlds #2518 clientstate9stalehelpers/clusters. Both require actual ast-grep TS+TSX beforedeletion. Verifier shared_review independently reviewingtoolbatch; ast_worlds frozenidle.

Next tool-validation concern to adjudicate: several single-lens --json modes print human prose on stdout ahead of JSON (e.g.contract-field-liveness/viewgap), so JSON.parse of stdout fails. Current scratch parsing strips anchored preamble; this is an audit workaround, not fixed tool output. Decide/fix machine-output contract with direct tests, no text-parsing protocol. Another known calibration candidate: Vite config default appears testonly even though prodonly already derives tooling config entrypoints; preserve live config, do not blanket absolve all exports in file.
